workUnits.name: Identify reference object instances
workUnits.purpose: Resolve identifier evidence into typed Reference objects while retaining unresolved client vocabulary as binding status.
workUnits.trigger: Identifier/reference evidence is present for a resolved canonical object.
atomicActions: Instantiate Reference objects with value, source-established type/type-scheme, issuer/role and related object; retain unresolved client vocabulary as binding status.
evidenceRequirements: Source value/context, related canonical object, unresolved vocabulary status where applicable.
workUnits.outputState: Reference objects are associated; unresolved client vocabulary remains explicit CLIENT_BINDING_REQUIRED.

workUnits.name: Extract or acquire candidate values from permitted evidence sources
workUnits.purpose: Acquire candidate values from governed evidence sources for identified objects.

blockingReasons: Frozen source names candidate acquisition and possible evidence objects but not the field/object-level permitted-source rule.

workUnits.name: Associate each candidate value to the correct canonical object instance
workUnits.purpose: Associate acquired candidate values to correct canonical object instances.
workUnits.trigger: Candidate values have been acquired and canonical object instances exist.
atomicActions: Associate each candidate value to its correct canonical object before validation or client mapping.
workUnits.outputState: Candidate values are attached to canonical object instances.

workUnits.name: Normalize values into canonical domains and units
workUnits.purpose: Normalize resolved values into canonical domains and units.

blockingReasons: Frozen source requires normalization but does not define the canonical domain/unit conversion rules.
Task-level applicability policies exist, but general per-field/per-object criteria are incomplete outside specifically sourced families.

workUnits.name: Run field, cross-field and cross-object validation
workUnits.purpose: Execute applicable field, cross-field and cross-object validation rules.

blockingReasons: Frozen source names validation categories but not the complete actual validation rules for this generic step.

workUnits.name: Resolve source conflicts using authority policy
workUnits.purpose: Resolve conflicting source evidence using governed authority/source-of-truth policy.

blockingReasons: Frozen source requires declared source-of-truth resolution but does not define actual precedence.

workUnits.name: Determine confidence and human-review requirement
workUnits.purpose: Determine whether confidence/validation permits STP or requires governed human review.

blockingReasons: Low-confidence handling is understood, but the active governed threshold is client/runtime-specific.

workUnits.name: Emit validated canonical objects plus explicit binding/pending statuses
workUnits.purpose: Emit canonical object graph, validation state and explicit unresolved statuses.
workUnits.trigger: Applicable resolution/validation processing has completed or reached an explicit governed blocker.
atomicActions: Emit versioned canonical object graph with validation state and explicit CLIENT_BINDING_REQUIRED/SOURCE_CONTEXT_PENDING/BLOCKED statuses.
evidenceRequirements: Versioned canonical object graph, validation results, unresolved status register.
workUnits.outputState: Canonical output is emitted with explicit resolution/binding state.

workUnits.name: Map only after canonical resolution to client/runtime fields and target systems
workUnits.purpose: Project canonical information only after canonical resolution.

blockingReasons: Canonical work is understood, but governing target client/runtime schema mapping is absent.
